name: The Roaring Discourse: Talking Lion
tag: Turns one photo into a talking host in a podcast studio, ready to post.

scenarios.title: Make a mascot intro clip
scenarios.ask: Use our lion mascot photo to record a podcast intro of {secs} in a {voice} voice with {angles} camera angles.
steps: Photo prep
Found the face in your photo and mapped 68 points around the mouth, eyes and mane.
Voice
Turned your script into {secs} of speech, about {=round(secs * (2.2 + voice * 0.2))} words.
Lip sync
Matched mouth shapes to the audio across {=secs * 30} frames at 30 frames per second.
Studio
Placed the lion at a desk with a microphone and set up {angles} camera angles with {=max(0, angles * 2 - 2)} cuts.
Render
Exported wide and vertical versions with captions.
followups: Use a photo you own or have permission to use. Clear, front-facing photos with even light give the best mouth movement.
Can I record my own voice instead?
Yes. Upload a voice track and the lip sync follows your recording instead of the generated voice.
What if the mane hides the mouth?
Photo prep marks the mouth area for you to confirm before rendering, so you can adjust it in a few clicks.

scenarios.title: Run a weekly show
scenarios.ask: We want {eps} episodes a month, {mins} each, with the lion as host. Format: {cohost}.
steps: Script writer
Drafted {eps} episode outlines from your topic list, about {=mins * 140} words each.
Voice
Generated {=cohost} voice track(s) per episode and balanced the levels.
Lip sync
Animated {=eps * mins * cohost} minutes of talking footage this month.
Editor
Added the studio intro, lower-third titles and an end card to every episode.
Captioner
Wrote caption files and a short description for each episode.
followups: Does the host look the same every week?
Yes. The lion's photo, voice and studio set are saved as a profile, so every episode matches.
Can I review scripts before they are voiced?
Yes. Nothing is voiced until you approve the script. Edits take seconds and the voice regenerates.
How long does a month take to produce?
Rendering {=eps * mins * cohost} minutes takes roughly {=round(eps * mins * cohost * 0.5)} minutes of machine time. Your time goes into approving scripts.

scenarios.title: Cut social clips from an episode
scenarios.ask: Turn our {ep} episode into {clips} short clips of {cliplen} each for social posts.
steps: Transcriber
Transcribed the full {ep} and marked who speaks when.
Highlight finder
Scored {=ep * 4} candidate moments by energy, laughs and quotable lines.
Clipper
Cut the top {clips} moments to {cliplen} each and kept full sentences.
Reframer
Re-centered the lion for vertical screens and added burned-in captions.
followups: Yes. The other {=max(0, ep * 4 - clips)} scored moments stay in a list, and swapping one in re-cuts it in seconds.
Do clips keep the studio look?
Yes. Each clip keeps the studio background and adds a small show logo in the corner.
